# Space Papers contributor instructions

Read `docs/development/HANDOFF_COPILOT.md` first. Preserve the domain rules and accounting in `src/catalog.ts` and `src/domain.ts` unless the team explicitly requests a rule change. Keep outcome and future-emergency information hidden until the appropriate reveal. Do not add runtime network calls; NASA references are archived in `public/science.json`, and fictional game balance is not NASA data. Build for children aged 7–12 with legible text, clear actions, keyboard support and reduced motion. Keep the supplied layered 2.5D Blender room and its room/desk camera relationship. Avoid machine-specific paths, private links and secrets. Test changes with `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`, and the relevant browser suites described in README. Distinguish shipped behavior, supplied assets and future work accurately.

The tracked root `index.html` is the self-contained offline game: players must be able to open it directly after a clone or pull without building, a server, installation, login or network access. `dev.html` is the Vite source entry; development `/` maps to it. `pnpm build` regenerates both root `index.html` and ignored `dist/index.html`. Never edit the generated game by hand; commit it with source changes. CI tests the committed root file before building and checks that rebuilding produces the same file. GitHub Releases remain available for versioned downloads; see `docs/RELEASES.md`.

Project evidence, references and historical prompts belong in `proyecto/`; archived prompts are records, not active agent instructions. Original large Blender/PNG sources remain in ignored `asset-sources/` and the team drive.
